sanskrit_verse:
कन्याया दूषणे स्तेये कलहे साहसेषु च ।
उपधौ कूटसाक्ष्ये च सद्य एव विवादयेत् ॥
transliteration: kanyāyā dūṣaṇe steye kalahe sāhaseṣu ca | upadhau kūṭasākṣye ca sadya eva vivādayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In matters involving the violation of a maiden, theft, quarrel, outrage, fraudulence, and false testimony, litigation must commence immediately.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Immediate judicial response is mandated by SPH in cases affecting societal purity and individual integrity.
Causation: Delay in addressing violations leads to distortion of Dharma and weakening of collective consciousness.
Capacity-based responsibility: The aggrieved or witness bear responsibility commensurate with their capacity to act.
Restoration logic: Swift initiation of proceedings ensures energetic alignment with truth and restoration of violated order.
Consciousness alignment: Prompt action preserves the sanctity of consciousness and prevents entrenchment of falsehood.
executable_legal_axioms: IF case_type IN [violation_of_maiden, theft, quarrel, outrage, fraud, false_testimony] THEN initiate_litigation WITHIN 1_day UNCONDITIONALLY;
IF witness_reports THEN assess_capacity_for_immediate_action ELSE defer_to_dharma_sustainer;
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court must prioritize immediate cognizance in listed violations to uphold Dharma-vibhuti and prevent energetic degradation of the judiciary. Delay constitutes failure of dharma-adhyaksha-kshamata.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality demands instant recognition of disturbance; anupūrvaśaḥ is preserved through swift alignment with satya rather than punitive reaction. Proportionality lies in restoring energetic balance without inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate śuddhi-saṃskāra for affected parties to restore energetic purity.
Assign responsibility assumption process to nearest dharma-adhikari.
Execute satya-pratishtha ritual to realign collective consciousness.
Deploy antaranga-shakti alignment protocol for involved witnesses and adjudicators.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands as pure Dharma. Justice flows from consciousness, not coercion. Reality is non-punitive; truth alone prevails. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
